records.title: MK-Curve QR / Python port
records.method: Reuse protocol/design checks and LAPACK workspace sizes while keeping the same pivoted QR and full b0 grid.

records.title: MK-Curve signal reuse
records.method: Within each chunk, reuse non-b0 signals and their logarithms across the full synthetic-b0 scan; update only the candidate b0 column.
records.baseline: The preceding qualified-QR Python implementation versus added signal reuse; solver, grid, correction rules and one numerical thread stay fixed.
records.unchanged: Original/corrected coefficients, complete curves, parameter maps, residuals and validity masks match exactly in all three acquisitions and both solvers.
records.limitation: Displayed medians use acquisition 1, selected consistently with the earlier QR record. Three alternating repeats after one warmup. Batched-path changes range from -1.50% to +3.07%, so signal reuse remains enabled only for the reference solver. These incremental timings overlap the earlier QR implementation and are not additive.
records.sample: Three acquisitions, 64 voxels each, 181 measurements and 200-201 synthetic-b0 samples. Reference-QR time falls 10.24-11.26%. Numeric computation only; input preparation and file export excluded.
records.upstream_reference: Recorded 29 October with SciPy 1.18.1; source/input checksums and one-thread settings are preserved. This is an incremental comparison within the Python port, following the qualified QR change.
